'''Yanase Berlitz''' (Japanese: '''ヤナセ・ベルリッツ''' ''Yanase Berlitz''), also known as '''Professor Yanase''' (Japanese: '''ヤナセ教授''' ''Professor Yanase''), is a recurring character in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==History==
===Prior to {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===
Yanase Berlitz first appears in a flashback in ''[[PS264|It All Ends Now V]]''. She was one of the scientists involved with the attempt to create an artificial [[Jade Orb|Green Orb]] to control {{p|Rayquaza}} in order to prevent any future disasters that would come about if {{p|Kyogre}} and {{p|Groudon}} were awakened. When a {{p|Salamence}} broke into the lab and started rampaging, Rayquaza was freed from its cage, and the laboratory was destroyed. Yanase and the other injured scientists were found by [[Norman]], who had fought Rayquaza shortly after it escaped.

==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===
In ''[[PS331|The Final Battle IV]]'', Yanase decided to abandon the project and threw the last remaining Green Orb core into a lake. {{adv|Emerald}} would later come across the core and wore it as an accessory on his head.

==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===
Yanase appeared as a cameo in [[PS611]] when [[Norman]] told {{adv|Ruby}} that the operation to capture and study {{p|Rayquaza}} was funded by the House of Berlitz.

==={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}===
Yanase officially debuts in this chapter. She is first seen out on sea, talking to her assistant about the traditions of her family. As they talk, Yanase gets a call from Platinum over the [[Pokégear]]. Yanase tells Platinum that she found information on where her original bodyguards, [[Paka and Uji]], were sent after being defeated by [[Team Galactic]]. Yanase tells Platinum that they may have been sent to the [[Distortion World]].

==={{MangaArc|Platinum}}===
Later, Yanase meets with [[Bebe]] and [[Daisy Oak]] at the hospital in the Sinnoh Pokémon Association headquarters. She and Daisy reveal that Platinum's Pokémon have developed [[Pokérus]]. At the end of the eighth chapter, Yanase appears before Professor Rowan and Mr. Berlitz at [[Sunyshore City]]. She tells the two that she and Platinum will be happy to help them in their research.

==={{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}}===
Yanase appeared in [[Faba]]'s flashback in ''[[PASM33|Tyrant!! The Fiendish Man!]]''.

==Character==
Yanase is a member of the [[house of Berlitz]] where she is the wife of Mr. Berlitz and the mother of {{adv|Platinum}}. Additionally, she is a scientist working for the [[Pokémon Association]]. As an heir to the house of Berlitz, Yanase at one point in her life traveled to [[Mt. Coronet]] in order to create a special accessory.
